heroSubtext: Hand-picked dresses, tops, skirts and two-piece sets — styled for Lagos weather, church, work and every owambe in between.
brandBlurb: Bold, feminine ready-to-wear for the woman who dresses like she means it.
aboutHeading: Style that travels from work to owambe
aboutPara1: Oyibo Leggings started with one simple frustration: finding pieces that actually fit, in fabrics that survive Lagos heat, at prices that make sense. So we started sourcing them ourselves.
aboutPara2: Today we curate a tight, deliberate rail — dresses, tops, skirts, leggings and two-piece sets — each one chosen because it looks as good in person as it does on the phone screen. Nothing is listed until we've seen the fabric, checked the stitching and tried the fit.
address: Shop FA11, Fulham Plaza, Balogun Market (opposite Oluwole Urban Mall), Lagos, Nigeria
deliveryInfo: Same-day within Lagos, 2–4 days to every other state in Nigeria.
paymentInfo: Bank transfer or cash on pickup — confirm details with us on WhatsApp before you pay.
